description: Eraserhead Xiu Xiu is a new live concert with accompanying film & full-length album that uses field recordings, concert specific homemade instruments, organ, modular synths, vocals, flashlights, electrical interference, and elements of musique concrete to express the bizarre emotionality, conflicted sexuality, relentless darkness, and singularly unsettled moonscape of this most incredible of midnight masterpieces.

title: Happy Burstday!
description: A girl who receives no birthday wishes picks up a cake knife and sets out for revenge.

title: Return to a Strange Land
description: In this nostalgic and yet dramatic documentary, choreographer Jiří Kylián creates a final work for his lifelong partner Sabine, a deeply personal performance that celebrates love, creation, and the ephemeral nature of life.

title: Anna by the Window
description: A filmic portrait of 24 hours in the life of an aimless teen boy as he avoids his overbearing artist father and AI startup founder brother.

title: O rio sobe a serra
description: The river goes up the mountain

title: I Can't Keep Doing This
description: Both a cynical riposte to the hypocrisies of how teaching is presented at recruitment versus the realities of working within modern education, as well as being a sensitive ode to the teachers that care most.  "An incredibly strong, wry and moving work" - Mark Lyken, filmmaker and artist

title: Break Time
description: Kyung-jun receives an offer from his old orphanage buddy, Jae-hyun, to rob a local soup joint that "only takes cash." What they thought would be an easy score takes a wildly unexpected turn with the sudden arrival of one man.

title: Terreno
description: Terrain explores the ruins of a motel in São Gonçalo and draws sensory parallels with the construction of the Rio-Niterói Bridge.

title: Schwarze Häuser
description: After World War II, countless children throughout Germany were sent to health resorts in order to recover; instead they endured systemic abuse. Through survivors’ voices and her own family history, filmmaker Katrin Sikora uncovers this long silenced chapter and its echoes across generations.

title: Do Stars Know Fear?
description: Trapped operative confronts cunning foil amid tense, futuristic space hemisphere.

title: PAN DE AJO
description: Victor, a shy and anxious guy, goes to Gabriel's apartment for the money he owes him. When he opens the door to Gabriel's room he will find nothing but horror...

title: Sunlit
description: What am I to myself?

title: Operation Kino
description: A trio of thieves infiltrate a movie theater to obtain an object

title: Soulmate
description: Jalte spends most of his time in the digital worlds of virtual reality. In his loneliness, he creates Selina – an AI companion designed to become his perfect soulmate. But as their relationship deepens, the line between artificial intimacy and real human connection begins to blur.

title: My Little Nothing
description: Two voices, one written, the other synthesised, engage in a philosophical dialogue about the amorous abyss separating them: a nineteen-year-old girl has decided to marry the Devil.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
description: The fifth night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 4, 2026, at Yamagata Big Wing in Yamagata, Japan.

title: Eyes Like Diamonds
description: Passionate conservationist Neil Waters embarks on a decade-long search through Tasmania’s wilderness to prove the Tasmanian Tiger still exists. Once celebrated but now ridiculed, his quest becomes a moving story of belief, science, redemption, and the ethics of extinction.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 4
description: The fourth night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 2, 2026, at Tokorozawa Municipal Gymnasium in Tokorozawa, Saitama, Japan.

title: Pine Hollow
description: …After uncovering a hidden clue tied to a local treasure, a group of teens embark on a treasure hunt through an unforgiving forest, where each discovery brings them closer to the truth and farther from the lives they knew.

title: A Shadow in the Corner of the Room
description: Down-on-her-luck nurse, Avery, dismisses a care home resident's warnings of a shadowy presence as dementia...until it begins to turn its attention to her.

title: City of Palys
description: The film introduces architect Jurgis Rimvydas Palys, his multifaceted world, and the city of Kaunas, which he spent his entire life shaping.

title: Una isla donde solo sopla buen viento
Grave of the Fireflies
description: In the final months of World War II, 14-year-old Seita and his sister Setsuko are orphaned when their mother is killed during an air raid in Kobe, Japan. After a falling out with their aunt, they move into an abandoned bomb shelter. With no surviving relatives and their emergency rations depleted, Seita and Setsuko struggle to survive.

title: Hotarubi no Mori e
description: One hot summer day a little girl gets lost in an enchanted forest of the mountain god where spirits reside. A young boy appears before her, but she cannot touch him for fear of making him disappear. And so a wondrous adventure awaits...

title: We Bark in the Same Tone of Voice
Downeast Hardcore: Stories From The Kave
description: In rural Maine, Kathy Findlay’s underground venue became a refuge for isolated teenagers, where a local scene supported by bands like Agnostic Front, Terror, 100 Demons, and Slapshot offered a sense of belonging.

title: Mungchi
description: In 2000, "Mungchi" became a global sensation as the star of the hit children's program Mungchi and Friends. However, for reasons unknown, the actor behind the character has long refused to remove the mascot suit. As rumors swirl regarding their true identity, Mungchi finally takes off the suit.
